basis: Hemodialysis oil trial measures inflammatory, oxidative and lipid markers.

Omega-3 trial includes a mixed comparator with pumpkin seed, flaxseed, evening primrose, canola and black currant oils. Timed mobility cannot isolate pumpkin seed oil and the registry does not describe a Parkinson cohort.
Combination oral spray in cancer-treatment mucositis. Primary grade incorporates pain and ability to eat. Results are unverified.
Maternal choline study examines infant development and auditory sensory gating.
Hair-growth outcome in androgenetic alopecia.
Postmenopausal oral oil trial. Blood pressure, pressure-wave reflection and stiffness are distinct from orthostatic lightheadedness.
Dietary oil trial in hyperlipidemia. The primary paper reports pressure was measured and leaves the arm estimates and registry enrollment mismatch unresolved.
Premenopausal oil capsules with systolic and diastolic endpoints. Results are unverified.
Hemodialysis oil supplementation. Oxidative stress, inflammatory and lipid measurements.
Oral oil or raw seeds in postmenopause. Published abstract reports no clear resting pressure change after oil. Linked dissertation remains inaccessible.
Extract exposure with bladder questionnaire endpoints.
Mixed oral supplement study with hair outcomes.
Vitamin D vehicle study measures gestational diabetes, birth weight and gestational age.
Vitamin D administration in type 1 diabetes with immune, insulin and calcium measures.
Peanut oil softgel comparator. Falls registered, publication reports gait speed and grip strength. Parkinson disease was among screening exclusions.
Menopausal hormone and placebo study records mammographic breast density and biopsy.
Cassava with and without oil evaluated vitamin A equivalency in women.
Peanut oil comparator in dyslipidemia. Metabolic, resting pressure and immune outcomes.
Peanut oil in a fortified food. Pediatric malnutrition and cognitive-motor development.
Carotenoid bioavailability experiment. Biomarker endpoint.
Vitamin D storage in adipose tissue. Withdrawn with biomarker endpoints.
Progesterone vehicle context, twin pregnancy and offspring outcomes.
Vitamin D carrier. Colitis remission, fecal and bone markers. Withdrawn.
Mixed refined coconut and peanut oil comparator. Infant allergy and maternal gastrointestinal endpoints.
ARISTOTLE randomized healthy adults. Peanut oil-based comparator formulation was identified in the paper. HADS depression and anxiety outcomes lack an isolated oil comparison.
Registry wording describes no intervention. The protocol and outcome paper identify matched intranasal peanut oil as the comparator for postviral olfactory loss.
Intranasal whole pumpkin fruit prepared in sesame oil. Insomnia and daytime dysfunction. Registered 74 planned, publication reports 100 randomized and 74 analyzed.
